youtube.title: Why Your Stomach Growls 🫃 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your stomach isn't growling because it's hungry. It's growling because it's empty.

Your gut muscles squeeze all day, pushing food, gas and liquid along. When it's full, the food muffles the sound. About two hours after you eat, a cleaning wave sweeps out the leftovers, and with nothing to muffle it, the gas and liquid gurgle loud.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
